lines.text: Open the light? Not in English!
Many learners say: Please open the light.
Better: Please turn on the light.
Lights turn on. They do not open.
Turn on! Please turn on the computer.

data.why: Lights turn on. They do not open.

native.tip: Tiếng Việt nói “mở đèn”, nhưng tiếng Anh dùng “turn on” cho đèn, TV, quạt.
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “Please open the light.” không? 💡 Đèn, TV, quạt dùng “turn on”: “Please turn on the light.” Nghe cô Ama đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “turn on.” Tối nay bật đèn, nhớ nói “turn on the light” nhé! Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.tip: Many learners say “open” for lights, but English uses “turn on” for lights, TVs, and fans.
en.caption: Do you often say this? “Please open the light.” Say “Please turn on the light.” instead. Listen to Ama, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
